d.title: Space Adventure Cobra
d.synopsis: While enjoying a drink at a bar, a beautiful yet intimidating woman catches the eye of Cobra, an infamous outlaw with a powerful gun fused to his left arm. This woman, Jane Royal, has also caught the eye of the Pirate Guild, a dangerous organization led by the enigmatic Crystal Bowie. As Cobra helps Jane escape the Pirate Guild and find her missing sisters, he discovers that she might just hold the fate of the galaxy in her hands.
